issues.display_title: Issue #1917: Enforce Sub-Agent Video Creation Restrictions and Resolve PHP Type Error
issues.main_description_html:
Description:

Fix unhandled server errors when sub-agent accounts attempt to generate videos, and implement clean authorization guards preventing unauthorized video creation for sub-agents (reported for user_id: 56439). Currently, generating a 360 Video throws a generic "Invalid input" error, while Walkthrough Video crashes with a PHP fatal error: "count(): Argument #1 ($value) must be of type Countable|array, int given".

Result & Resolution:

Resolved via PR #1919 (Merged).

1. Root Causes & Fixes:

  1. 360 Video (`POST /upload/360v-create`):
    • Cause: `time_per_slide` and `bg_music` were marked as `required` in `Create360Video.php`. The frontend (`gothru-dashboard`) sends `time_per_slide: null` by default, triggering an immediate `409 Invalid input`.
    • Fix: Rules relaxed to `nullable` with type constraints (`integer|min:0` for music, `numeric` for slide time) and normalized to integers with default fallback (4s / music 0).
  2. Walkthrough Video (`POST /walkthrough/project` & `POST /v1/walkthrough/project`):
    • Cause: `VideoAppClass::getPaymentStatus()` called `count($toursSubagent)` on an integer count returned by `getPublishedMonthlyVideo()`. In PHP 8, this caused a fatal error: `TypeError: count(): Argument #1 ($value) must be of type Countable|array, int given` when sub-agent accounts (like `56439`) tried to create videos.
    • Fix: Fixed accumulation to `$total += $toursSubagent;`, removed premature returns on non-subagent branch, and corrected `$aPost['time_per_slide'] = 8` to `$nrSeconds = 8;`.

2. Verification Completed:

  • Unit Tests:
    • `Create360VideoActionTest.php` (12 tests, 22 assertions) — 100% Passed.
    • `VideoAppClassTest.php` (4 tests, 10 assertions) — 100% Passed.
  • Playwright E2E Tests:
    • `gothru-dashboard/qa_testing/e2e/tour/video_360_create.spec.js` (13 tests across 3 runs) — 100% Passed.
  • Dry-Run (User 56439):
    • All 9 tours owned by sub-agent `56439` passed 360 Video validation cleanly without `409 Invalid input`.
    • Walkthrough payment calculation evaluated successfully to `'free'` without fatal type errors.

issues.display_title: Issue #1918: Endpoint to Retrieve Scheduled Tours Ordered by Deactivate Date
issues.main_description_html:
Description:

Provide an authenticated API endpoint to fetch all scheduled virtual tours for the current user/account, sorted by deactivate_at ascending.

RESULT

Branch: feat/1918-retrieve-scheduled-tours
PR: #1920 (merged)
Related FE Task: GoThruMedia/gothru-dashboard#4307 (API contract commented) · FE PR: GoThruMedia/gothru-dashboard#4309

Endpoint

  • GET /virtualtours/scheduled (auth)
  • Query params: overlay_type (hosted | google, default hosted), limit (default 100, max 200)
  • Sorted by deactivate_at ASC (nulls last), then activate_at ASC

Response Contract (plain enc=false)

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "messages": "Data retrieved",
    "tours": [
      {
        "mid": 101,
        "moderation_id": 101,
        "tour_id": 1234,
        "tour_key": "6B3p9zQ",
        "tour_name": "Luxury Beachfront Villa",
        "base_url_tour": "https://tourmkr.com",
        "tour_link": "https://tourmkr.com/F16B3p9zQ",
        "activate_at": "2026-09-20 08:00:00",
        "deactivate_at": "2026-09-24 18:00:00"
      }
    ]
  }
}

Verification (local E2E, account muhamad.rifky.dev@gmail.com)

  • ✅ Login via POST /auth/login → 200 + token
  • ✅ GET /virtualtours/scheduled?enc=false → {"statusCode":200,"data":{"messages":"Data retrieved","tours":[]}} (account has no scheduled tours yet — contract OK)
  • ✅ Browser-level auth via Playwright (login_with_session.spec.js) passed with the same account
